shortDescription: Create, Modify and Delete Cisco FMC network objects

options.name: action
options.description: Action to take with the specified group members Allowed values are (C(add)) or (C(remove)) Required when state = "present"

options.name: auto_deploy
options.description: Option to deploy configurations to deployable devices after changes

options.name: fmc
options.description: IP address or FQDN of Cisco FMC.

options.name: group_literals
options.description: Network to be added to the network group Accepted value is a list of valid IPv4 addresses,IPv4 address ranges or IPv4 network addresses

options.name: group_objects
options.description: FMC Objects to be added to/removed from the network group If the objects do not exist on the FMC, this will be ignored

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the cisco_fmc object to be created, modified or deleted.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to create/modify (C(present)), or remove (C(absent)) an object.

options.name: username
options.description: Cisco FMC Username User should have sufficient permissions to modify objects
